scope: Written by verify-spell-routes.cjs: every spell typed and aimed by its first class in seven places of a written story (inn, landmark, after a won fight, after victory, the story fight, a fight in the wilds, a brawl). "automatic" is resolved by the game, "narrated" is spent by the game and described by the Dungeon Master, "ruling" waits for a Dungeon Master ruling the game then applies; a refusal is listed with its reason.
